QuestInfo.name: Asking After Shumi, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to check on #b#p403##k, a resident of the city. Let's go see how #p403# is doing. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I checked on #p403#, a resident of #m10003000#. In a city like this, no news is the best news.

0.0: "I'm curious to know how #p403#, one of our residents in #m10003000#, is doing lately. And hey, don't get the wrong idea—I'm absolutely NOT asking because I'm wondering when they're going to return what they borrowed from me or anything. Anyway, I'd appreciate it if you could go check on them for me.\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: Hey, #h0#! Looks like you've been doing well, huh? Heh! Wait, you're asking what I'm doing just sitting here every day? You really don't get it, do you? If you hang out right here, you get to watch so many different kinds of people!
1.1: See that subway station behind me? I don't really know the details, but tons of adventurers head inside there every single day. And get this—they all buy a crazy amount of lemons before going in! I mean, what in the world is even happening down there?
1.2: To be honest, I tried going in once before, but fierce monsters were running wild right at the entrance, so I had no choice but to run away immediately. If you're planning on checking it out too, you'd better be well prepared!

level.0: But you... your level is, like, way too low?
